sources.title: Ciudades donde opera DiDi en Costa Rica
sources.proves: Official city list names Liberia, San Carlos and San José; Liberia is the exact gateway overlap for Papagayo/Guanacaste.

sources.title: Costa Rica recibió 2,6 millones de turistas durante el 2024
sources.proves: 2,661,488 air tourist arrivals in 2024; 881,289 entered through Daniel Oduber airport in Guanacaste. These are catchment totals, not water-route demand.

sources.title: Tarifas del ferry (Cabotaje Mayor)
sources.publisher: Autoridad Reguladora de los Servicios Públicos (ARESEP)
sources.proves: Regulated adult fares effective 2026-07-01: CRC 810 Puntarenas–Paquera and CRC 1,000 Puntarenas–Playa Naranjo; identifies Naviera Tambor and COONATRAMAR.

sources.title: Horarios y tarifas
sources.proves: Current Paquera timetable shown as eight daily departure times in each direction and adult fare CRC 810; timetable says in force from 20 April 2026 until further notice.

sources.title: Marina Papagayo
sources.proves: Official existence of Marina Papagayo as a marine access facility in the resort cluster.

sources.title: Socios Conductores en Ciudad de Panamá
sources.proves: Official exact-city evidence for DiDi Express in Panama City; does not prove service at Cartí or in Guna Yala.

sources.title: Gunayala: Discover Idyllic Islands and Ancient Culture
sources.publisher: Visit Panamá / Autoridad de Turismo de Panamá
sources.proves: Official destination evidence: Gunayala/San Blas is an Indigenous destination with more than 365 islands and sustainable-tourism positioning. No route passenger volume is stated.

sources.title: San Blas Panama, Complete Guide
sources.publisher: Guna Yala Panama Travel (licensed local, 100% Guna-operated operator)
sources.proves: Advance coordination, three official ports, local self-rule, 365 islands/49 inhabited/32 tourism-open, and Guna-operated tourism context.

sources.title: San Blas Day Tour from Cartí Port
sources.proves: Current excursion pattern from port to islands; operator material describes approximately 30–35 minute boat legs to several excursion islands. It does not provide annual passenger flow.

sources.title: Ciudades donde opera DiDi en República Dominicana
sources.proves: Official list names La Romana, Puerto Plata, Punta Cana, San Francisco de Macorís, San Pedro de Macorís, Santiago and Santo Domingo; Samaná is not listed. Supports country presence, not exact Samaná service.

sources.title: Informe de inversiones: Samaná
sources.publisher: Ministerio de Turismo de República Dominicana / SITUR
sources.proves: Official Samaná tourism supply: about 2.6K rooms across 46 open hotels; 15 approved 2023–2024 projects with 877 rooms and US$113.1M investment. Supply is not route demand.

sources.title: Anuncian preparativos para la temporada de ballenas jorobadas en Samaná
sources.proves: 61,558 whale-watch visitors traveled to Samaná in Q1 2024: 40,667 foreign (66.1%) and 20,891 local. This is seasonal destination demand, not one ferry route.

sources.title: Inicio de la Temporada 2025 de Observación de Ballenas Jorobadas en Samaná
sources.publisher: Ministerio de Medio Ambiente y Recursos Naturales, República Dominicana
sources.proves: Official 2025 whale-observation season ran 15 January through 31 March under an interinstitutional conservation agreement.

sources.title: Statistical Report of Commercial Air Transport in the Dominican Republic 2024
sources.publisher: Junta de Aviación Civil, República Dominicana
sources.proves: Official report covers El Catey/Samaná airport; 2024 airport passenger total used here is 101,555. This is airport throughput, not water-route demand.

sources.title: Ferry to Sabana de la Mar from Samaná
sources.proves: Reseller offers the public bay crossing as a one-hour trip at US$16 at access time. Verify at operator/wharf before economics.

sources.title: Ferry Tickets: Samaná & Sabana de la Mar
sources.proves: Search-indexed current seller page lists Samaná departures at 09:00, 11:00, 15:00 and 16:20. Page was bot-blocked during full read; confirm directly.
